text: Then answered{H6030} Eliphaz{H464} the Temanite,{H8489} and said,{H559}
If one assay{H5254} to commune{H1697} with thee, wilt thou be grieved?{H3811} But who can{H3201} withhold{H6113} himself from speaking?{H4405}
Behold, thou hast instructed{H3256} many,{H7227} And thou hast strengthened{H2388} the weak{H7504} hands.{H3027}
Thy words{H4405} have upholden{H6965} him that was falling,{H3782} And thou hast made firm{H553} the feeble{H3766} knees.{H1290}
But now it is come{H935} unto thee, and thou faintest;{H3811} It toucheth{H5060} thee, and thou art troubled.{H926}
Is not thy fear{H3374} [of God] thy confidence,{H3690} [And] the integrity{H8537} of thy ways{H1870} thy hope?{H8615}
Remember,{H2142} I pray thee, who [ever] perished,{H6} being innocent?{H5355} Or where{H375} were the upright{H3477} cut off?{H3582}
According as I have seen,{H7200} they that plow{H2790} iniquity,{H205} And sow{H2232} trouble,{H5999} reap{H7114} the same.
By the breath{H5397} of God{H433} they perish,{H6} And by the blast{H7307} of his anger{H639} are they consumed.{H3615}
The roaring{H7581} of the lion,{H738} and the voice{H6963} of the fierce lion,{H7826} And the teeth{H8127} of the young lions,{H3715} are broken.{H5421}
The old lion{H3918} perisheth{H6} for lack{H1097} of prey,{H2964} And the whelps{H1121} of the lioness{H3833} are scattered abroad.{H6504}

Fear{H6343} came{H7122} upon me, and trembling,{H7461} Which made all{H7230} my bones{H6106} to shake.{H6342}
Then a spirit{H7307} passed{H2498} before my face;{H6440} The hair{H8185} of my flesh{H1320} stood up.{H5568}

It stood still,{H5975} but I could not discern{H5234} the appearance{H4758} thereof; A form{H4758} was before mine eyes:{H5869} [There was] silence,{H1827} and I heard{H8085} a voice,{H6963} [saying],
Shall mortal man{H582} be more just{H6663} than God?{H433} Shall a man{H1397} be more pure{H2891} than his Maker?{H6213}
Behold, he putteth no trust{H539} in his servants;{H5650} And his angels{H4397} he chargeth{H7760} with folly:{H8417}
How much more{H637} them that dwell{H7931} in houses{H1004} of clay,{H2563} Whose foundation{H3247} is in the dust,{H6083} Who are crushed{H1792} before{H6440} the moth!{H6211}
